scope: Reduced cold-gas equilibrium experiment; not an original FGH figure reproduction
abundance_source: Field et al. (1968), Table 1, p. 958, citing Allen (1963)
assumptions: Equal primary ionization rate for H I, He I, He II; no secondary or thermal collisional ionization.
Hjellming (1966), equations 56-59: excited-state recombination; He I approximated by H and He II by hydrogenic Z=2 scaling. Cold-temperature accuracy is not established here.
Low-density cooling with all C, Si, Fe singly ionized and O neutral; each tabulated transition uses the whole elemental target population. Level statistical equilibrium is omitted.
Only available Table 1 collider channels enter the reduced cooling sum; omitted channels are not measured zeros.
Two charge prescriptions: H/He only, and explicit C+Si+Fe donor electrons; neither includes all historical trace donors.
Recombination energy uses Hjellming gamma-minus-gamma1; free-free cooling uses GHF equation 18. No thermal H/He excitation cooling, molecules, grains, or stellar heating.
n0 counts H+He nuclei; P/k=(n0+ne)*T omits trace nuclei. No stability classification or warm branch is inferred.
